'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Mark Walseth LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Walseth]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Obi FTW
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
